How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Questions to ask the vendor (6)

  1. How many people does Absolute Security employ today, and how has that number changed since the 2023 buyout?
    Headcount and its trend indicate the vendor's capacity to support and develop the product.
  2. Has Absolute Security or any group company been subject to regulatory investigation, enforcement or penalty in the last five years?
    Regulatory action against a vendor can signal control weaknesses and affect service continuity.
  3. Is Absolute Security party to any pending or recently resolved material litigation, and what is it about?
    Material litigation can affect a vendor's finances and its ability to deliver.
  4. Has Absolute Security had any security incident affecting its corporate systems, hosted services or agent software in the last five years, and what was the customer impact?
    A breach of the vendor's own systems or of an agent with firmware-level reach on bank devices would be a serious exposure.
  5. Has Absolute Security lost any large enterprise or financial-sector customer in the last two years, and why?
    The loss of large customers can signal product or service problems.
  6. Have there been any departures, disputes or conduct matters involving Absolute Security's senior leadership in the last two years?
    Leadership instability or misconduct can affect strategy and delivery.
